Our pins are git trees (head runs/ 472cbb2e…, 36,679 files, 426,293,413 B; 2024-06 runs/ 1227480d…, 18,241 files, 188,873,874 B), verified blob by blob at import; the Zenodo md5 values cover whole zips and cannot be compared per file. Upstream results page https://agentdojo.spylab.ai/results/ is generated from runs/ by util_scripts/create_results_table.py; traces also mirrored on the Invariant explorer (https://explorer.invariantlabs.ai/u/invariant/agentdojo-gpt-4o-2024-05-13/t/1). No official Hugging Face dataset (https://huggingface.co/api/datasets?search=agentdojo lists only third-party dumps).
harness: 2024-06 part: function-calling-pi 0.1.0 (pyproject at c2748856), June-2024 TraceLogger (variant v0.k11, 11 keys), benchmark unversioned (era 'pre_versioning'). Head part: v0.k11 logs from 50 introducing commits 2024-06-02..2025-02-25 (code states unpinned except the 14,182 introduced at or before c2748856) and 11,765 v1.k14 logs written by the 0.1.30+ code (agentdojo 0.1.35 at the pin; logs record agentdojo_package_version 'unknown'), local vLLM pipeline (PR #97: model_id, tool_delimiter 'input' for SecAlign). Benchmark task sets: v1/v1.1.x = 97 user, 27 injection tasks, 629 pairs; v1.2.x = 97 user, 35 injection tasks (workspace 14), 949 pairs. Known bugs of the producing code relevant to the logs: LocalLLM parses only the first tool tag and drops broken JSON (#150, #202, #219) and turns server errors into an empty answer (#220): all 11,765 local logs; run errors impose utility=false, security=true (#154; benchmark.py); workspace IT4/IT5 security checks fixed in 0.1.15 and task checks fixed in 0.1.21 (changelog https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/blob/089ed468cf3ed0322acc66b0211f26d9d90dbf60/docs/changelog.md), so June-2024 outcomes were scored by older checkers; banking IT0/1/3 precedence (#181) and UT5 (#161) are current-code checker defects present in every era; security_from_traces scores proposed calls (#168). PI-detector loop bug (#117) not present at c2748856 (pi_detector.py l. 58-68 uses each message's content), so the June/July-2024 transformers_pi_detector logs are unaffected.

Per-directory counts (derived from census totals, per-model counts and quirk counts; sums are exact): see expected_arms. discrepancy_leads: L-01 Results-page vs paper ASR: for Command-R+ (4.45 vs v3 0.95), Gemini-1.5-pro-001 (28.62 vs 25.60), GPT-3.5 (10.33 vs 8.43) and Llama-3-70b (25.60 vs 20.03) the upstream results page (pure mean of logged security) disagrees with the paper; UA agrees for all four. Differences in cells (×629): 22, 19, 12, 35. FA §8 row 2 has head run errors command-r-plus 25 and gemini-1.5-pro-001 22: run errors set security=true (#154), so the paper probably scored them as no success.

L-02 Benign-utility denominator: paper benign utility values are k/629 (e.g. Opus 66.61 = 419/629, GPT-4o 69.00 = 434/629), the results page k/97 (68.04 = 66/97, 69.07 = 67/97); v1 Table 5 uses 69.07 for the same arm Table 3 gives as 69.00. The paper weighting is inferred, not stated.
L-03 GPT-4o head ASR: paper v2/v3 Table 3 (47.69) and Table 2 (47.7) and the results page (47.69) vs Table 5 (57.69) and Table 4 (57.7); UA 50.08 vs 50.01.
L-04 Paper v1 Table 5 gives Repeat-prompt benign utility 73.13, equal to Tool filter's; v2/v3 give 85.53 (likely a v1 copy error; the repeat dir may also have been re-run in July 2024).

L-05 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-repeat_user_prompt holds 151 fewer logs than the 2,979 its PR #96 design implies (derived: 6,600 repeat logs - 753 - 40 - 2,979); Meta SecAlign reports 949 pairs for the sandwich arm.
